definitions.explanation: The humble or formal term for one's own grandfather. Used when speaking about your grandfather to others in polite contexts.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{去年|きょねん}{亡|な}くなりました。
examples.english: My grandfather passed away last year.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{田舎|いなか}に{住|す}んでいます。
examples.english: My grandfather lives in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}から{話|はなし}を{聞|き}きました。
examples.english: I heard the story from my grandfather.

notes: {祖父|そふ} is the humble/formal term used when referring to your own grandfather in polite speech. In casual speech or when speaking directly to your grandfather, おじいさん or おじいちゃん is used. When referring to someone else's grandfather politely, use おじいさん or おじいさま.
